exposure: Application of PANICKERS PPH CANNULA to create negative pressure inside the uterine cavity
outcome: Amount of blood collected via suction
cohort: Forty-three women with different risk factors for atonic PPH, who delivered either normally or by caesarean section, were included in the study.
finding: Complete cessation of bleeding, associated with uterine contraction and firm retraction, was observed in most women within 4 minutes after initiating the procedure, with the amount of blood collected ranging from 50ml to 300ml.
